activity_summary: At rehearsal you left the owl's one moved stop where it was, and no word was changed. Pope heard the end of it and said the stop held. Nick was not given the song. He has the Princess, and Phillips set her first long speech for Thursday, walking. He goes to meet Heminges before noon, to be measured. You said the new comedy is not in front of a yard. You had come from Field's with no book, and you will ask again in Lent. No line of the play was spoken out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the division and named Lent for the book.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept both songs and set Thursday for the Princess.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Stayed with the Princess and did not take the owl.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Heard the stop and went to look at the cuff.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Named for Thursday. He was not in the room.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named as the man Nick goes to meet. He was not in the room.

facets.activity: Rehearsed the songs at the Cross Keys

quotes.speaker: thomas_pope
quotes.text: The stop holds. I heard the end.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: You will not send me a third before Lent.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: You have the songs. I have the comedy.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: That a book cannot walk home.
